hook.title: Saat readings, ek naam
hook.md:
Ek patient ka blood pressure hafte bhar har subah check hota hai. Ab tak jo aap jaante hain, usse saat variables chahiye honge: `bp1`, `bp2`, `bp3` wagairah. Ab sochiye ek mahine ki readings, ya chaalis patients wala ward.

Python ke paas behtar tareeka hai: saari readings, kram se, **ek naam** ke neeche rakho. Yeh container hai **list**. Asli data ka kaam lists se shuru hota hai: is unit mein milne wala har dataset, stock register se clinical trial tak, lists se bana hai.

learn: Square brackets se **list** banana, aur **len()** se ginna
**Indexing** se position ke hisaab se ek item chunna, **0** se shuru karke, aur aakhir se **-1** se
Kisi item ko **badalna**, kyunki lists **mutable** hain
**Slicing** se list ka ek hissa lena, aur list par loop chalana

explanation.heading: List banana
explanation.md:
**List** **square brackets** se likhi jaati hai, items commas se alag:

```python
medicines = ["Paracetamol", "Amoxicillin", "Cetirizine"]
print(medicines)
print(len(medicines))
print(type(medicines))
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
['Paracetamol', 'Amoxicillin', 'Cetirizine']
3
<class 'list'>
```

List items ko **usi kram mein** rakhti hai jismein aapne likha. `len()` items ginta hai, jaise Lesson 1.6 mein usne string ke letters gine the. List mein numbers, strings, ya dono ho sakte hain, aur `[]` khaali list hai.

callout.title: List
callout.md: Items ka kram wala collection, square brackets mein, commas se alag. Ek variable sabko rakhta hai.

explanation.heading: Indexing: ek item chunna
explanation.md:
Har item ka ek position number hota hai jise **index** kehte hain. Python ginti **0** se shuru karta hai, isliye pehla item index 0 par hai:

```python
medicines = ["Paracetamol", "Amoxicillin", "Cetirizine", "Metformin"]
print(medicines[0])
print(medicines[2])
print(medicines[-1])
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
Paracetamol
Cetirizine
Metformin
```

**Negative indexes** aakhir se ginte hain: `-1` aakhri item hai, `-2` usse pehle wala. Yeh tab kaam aata hai jab aapko latest reading chahiye aur pata nahi list kitni lambi hai.

callout.title: Pehla item [0] hai, [1] nahi
callout.md: 4 items wali list ke indexes 0, 1, 2 aur 3 hain. Index 4 maangne par IndexError: list index out of range aata hai.

explanation.heading: Item badalna
explanation.md:
String se alag, list banne ke baad badli ja sakti hai. Kisi item ko badalne ke liye `=` ke baayin taraf index lagaiye:

```python
stock = [40, 0, 25]
stock[1] = 60
print(stock)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
[40, 60, 25]
```

Doosra shelf khaali tha (0); restock ke baad usmein 60 hain. Kyunki lists badli ja sakti hain, isliye unhe **mutable** kehte hain.

explanation.heading: Slicing: list ka ek hissa lena
explanation.md:
**Slice** `list[start:stop]` index `start` se index `stop` tak ki nayi list deta hai, par `stop` **shaamil nahi** hota:

```python
bp = [128, 135, 142, 130, 126, 138]
print(bp[1:4])
print(bp[:3])
print(bp[3:])
print(bp[-2:])
print(bp[::2])
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
[135, 142, 130]
[128, 135, 142]
[130, 126, 138]
[126, 138]
[128, 142, 126]
```

- `bp[1:4]` indexes 1, 2 aur 3 leta hai.
- Pehle item se shuru karna ho to `start` chhod dijiye: `bp[:3]`.
- Aakhir tak jaana ho to `stop` chhod dijiye: `bp[3:]`.
- `bp[-2:]` aakhri do readings deta hai.
- Teesra number **step** hai: `bp[::2]` har doosri reading leta hai.

Slicing original list ko kabhi nahi badalta; woh nayi list banata hai.

callout.title: Slice mein items giniye
callout.md: stop ghata start: bp[1:4] mein 4 - 1 = 3 items hain. Slices strings par bhi bilkul aise hi kaam karte hain.

explanation.heading: List ke har item se guzarna
explanation.md:
`for` loop (Lesson 2.3) list ke har item par kram se jaata hai, aur `in` check karta hai ki koi value list mein hai ya nahi:

```python
medicines = ["Paracetamol", "Amoxicillin", "Cetirizine"]
for drug in medicines:
    print("Dispense:", drug)
print("Aspirin" in medicines)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
Dispense: Paracetamol
Dispense: Amoxicillin
Dispense: Cetirizine
False
```

`"Aspirin" in medicines` `False` hai kyunki is prescription mein Aspirin nahi hai. Agle lessons mein aap items jodenge, hataayenge aur sort karenge, aur tuples va dictionaries se milenge.

walkthrough.intro: Yeh program paanch din ki fasting blood sugar readings ek list mein rakhta hai, phir position se readings nikaalta hai.

keyTerms.meaning: Paanch readings ki list banao, kram se.
Ek slice: indexes 1, 2 aur 3 (stop shaamil nahi).

steps.say: Yeh program paanch din ki blood sugar readings ek list mein rakhta hai, phir unki position se readings nikaalta hai.
Comment batata hai yeh numbers kya hain: fasting blood sugar, milligrams per decilitre mein.
Square brackets list banaate hain. sugar mein ab paanch numbers hain, usi kram mein jismein likhe gaye.
sugar of zero pehli reading hai. Python positions zero se ginta hai, isliye yeh ek sau das hai.
Minus one aakhir se ginta hai, isliye sugar of minus one aakhri reading hai: ek sau paanch.
Slice one to four, position ek se shuru hokar position chaar se theek pehle rukta hai. Isse teen readings milti hain.
len list ke items ginta hai: paanch readings.

errors.intro: Yeh do errors aisa index use karne se aati hain jo kaam nahi karta.

examples.title: Aisa index maangna jo hai hi nahi
examples.md: List mein 3 items hain, isliye uske indexes 0, 1 aur 2 hain. Index 3 nahi hai. Aakhri item ke liye `medicines[2]` likhiye, ya usse behtar, `medicines[-1]`.

examples.title: Index mein decimal number use karna
examples.md: `/` hamesha float deta hai, isliye `middle` 1.5 hai, aur item 1.5 jaisa kuch nahi hota. Poora number paane ke liye floor division use kijiye: `middle = len(doses) // 2`.

mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par doosra item milta hai
mistakes.fix: Indexes 0 se shuru hote hain: pehla item `medicines[0]` hai.

mistakes.mistake: Ummeed karna ki `bp[1:3]` mein index 3 shaamil hoga
mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par slice mein ummeed se ek item kam hai
mistakes.fix: Stop index shaamil nahi hota: `bp[1:4]` indexes 1, 2 aur 3 deta hai.
Index square brackets mein jaata hai: `medicines[0]`.

mistakes.mistake: Text item ke quotes bhool jaana: `["Paracetamol", Ibuprofen]`
mistakes.fix: Har text item ko quotes chahiye: `["Paracetamol", "Ibuprofen"]`.

quiz.q:
meds = ["Aspirin", "Insulin", "Digoxin"]
print(meds[1])

Yeh kya print karta hai?
quiz.why: Indexes 0 se shuru hote hain, isliye meds[1] doosra item hai, Insulin.

quiz.q: List ke pehle item ka index kya hai?
quiz.why: Python list positions hamesha 0 se ginta hai.

quiz.q:
x = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
print(x[1:3])

Yeh kya print karta hai?
quiz.why: Slice indexes 1 aur 2 leta hai; stop index 3 shaamil nahi.
Negative indexes aakhir se ginte hain; -1 aakhri item hai.

quiz.q: Ek list mein 4 items hain. print(items[4]) se kya hota hai?
quiz.why: Indexes 0 se 3 hain, isliye index 4 hai hi nahi.

quiz.q: Lists ke baare mein kaun-si baat sahi hai?
quiz.why: Lists mutable hain: items badal, jod aur hata sakte hain.

exam.note: Practice ke liye important questions. University ke asli questions alag ho sakte hain.

summary: **List** kai items ko, kram se, ek variable mein rakhti hai: `drugs = ["Aspirin", "Insulin"]`. `len()` unhe ginta hai.
**Indexing** ek item chunta hai: pehla `[0]` hai, aakhri `[-1]`. Na hone wala index **IndexError** deta hai.
Lists **mutable** hain: `stock[1] = 60` ek item badal deta hai.
**Slice** `list[start:stop]` nayi list banata hai, `stop` tak par use shaamil kiye bina; `[::2]` har doosra item leta hai.
`for item in list:` har item par jaata hai, aur `x in list` check karta hai ki value maujood hai ya nahi.

steps.say: List sugar mein paanch readings hain. Har reading apni numbered jagah par hai, aur numbering zero se shuru hoti hai.
sugar of zero pehli jagah hai: ek sau das.
Minus one aakhir se ginta hai, isliye sugar of minus one aakhri jagah hai: ek sau paanch.
Slice one to four jagah ek, do aur teen leta hai. Yeh jagah chaar se pehle ruk jaata hai.

glossary.meaning: Square brackets mein items ka kram wala collection, ek variable mein: ["Aspirin", "Insulin"].
List mein kisi item ka position number. Ginti 0 se shuru hoti hai, isliye pehla item list[0] hai.
Aakhir se gina gaya index: list[-1] aakhri item hai, list[-2] usse pehle wala.
List ka ek hissa, list[start:stop], start se stop tak par stop shaamil nahi. Yeh nayi list banata hai.
Banne ke baad badla ja sakta hai. Lists mutable hain (stock[1] = 60 chalta hai); strings nahi.
Jab list mein na hone wala index maangein tab aane wali error, jaise 3 items wali list mein [3].
